summary: Candidate is a narrower, dependency-specific workflow that overlaps semantically with three existing Spring Boot 3.0 migration session skills. The candidate focuses on updating specific dependency versions (Flyway, Liquibase, Hibernate, R2DBC, Redis, MongoDB) as a sub-task within the broader pre-migration phase. It should merge into the existing readiness assessment (de93a384) as a detailed execution step, and cross-reference the dependency management migration (c646224e) and removed dependencies inventory (4dc93816) skills. The peer_candidates confirm this is part of a larger migration workflow family, not a standalone capability.
